newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Five dead in killing near Colombian capital.
newsitem.headline: Five dead in killing near Colombian capital.

text.p: The driver and four passengers of a four-wheel-drive vehicle were found shot dead in a gangland-style killing near the Colombian capital, authorites said Wednesday.
Police said the five victims, men aged between 26 and 45, died from gunshot wounds to the head. Their bodies were discovered inside their jeep on a highway 10 miles (16 km) north of Bogota.

In the first three months of this year, more than 160 people have died in 34 multiple killings in Colombia. Most of the attacks have been blamed on leftist guerrilla groups and right-wing death squads.
